export type Payment = { amount: number; voidedAt: string | null };

export function activeTotal(rows: Payment[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (row.voidedAt !== null) continue;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(row.amount)) {
      throw new RangeError('Active payment amount must be a safe integer');
    }
    const next = total + row.amount;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(next)) {
      throw new RangeError('Active payment total must be a safe integer');
    }
    total = next;
  }
  return total;
}
